title: Osimu Boss Fights
description: This mod adds very unforgiving bosses and cool rewards. Most of them will be glass cannons, strength alone won't be enough.
body:
This mod was originally made for a private server, but I figured why not publish it. Osimu Boss Fights is a mod that adds very hard and unfair bosses, usually glass cannons but something gimmicky bosses too. It takes from a wide range of other references and media, they won't be lore accurate, just made for fun.

**Strength alone won't be enough.**
# Starting out
As the way to summon bosses in this mod, craft a **Mimic Lure**.

![Mimic Lure recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6c6e4bab92b38a3940daaafcce830954765e80ea.png)![Mimic Lure block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7af8c3f173ef2c8abdc87d8211144a022794712b.png)
It has a single-slot UI, this is for putting bait inside. They will spawn on top of the block after around 2 minutes.
![Dried Chicken in Mimic Lure](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a43d740c3287bacb08858be5a4b1977064a4cdd0.png)

### Bait for each boss:
- **Frieren**: Any enchanted book.
- **Độ Mixi**: Dried chicken.

# Bosses
## Frieren
Has 100 HP, she will spawn in passive mod, attack her a bit for her to aggro. Shoots basic attack magic every second, plus after every few seconds, she will cast 1 of 5 Greater Spell onto everything around.
![Frieren in passive phase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95d2050a597663b62c2b057f4c7b5c7497e839c0.png)
## Độ Mixi
Has 120 HP, but spawns in with 7 glowing sugarcanes, each greatly enhances him to invicibility, it's recommended to defeat the sugarcanes first before dealing with him. Killing the sugarcane will summon 1 Vux minion to attack you.
![Do Mixi](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/90ab3e957a235c8ad12e49654f003adba1d57a9d.png)
You will need to craft Chicken Shreds to make Dried Chicken to summon him.
![Chicken Shreds recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/69421b270f306515f6d8a5b54c3abdc3eb0c744f.png)
### Osimate
Upon defeat, all bosses will drop Osimate and 1 unique loot, with can be used to craft different items. Additionally, Osimate Block is very slippery!
![Osimate and block of it](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cc6e37cfcde3588e262dfe01b3e8d72de81f31dc.png)
# Items
These are the items that can be dropped or crafted.
![Items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bbaaaf434c07f66ac8c9fad7f5ec78d1ee8bff10.png)
- **Frieren's Staff**: Dropped by Frieren, use to shoot Zoltraaks, requires Imaginaric effect
- **Vuphone**: Dropped by Độ Mixi, use to summon your own Vux, he resists fire and heals himself.
- **Rustblade**: Craftable, low damage and slow attack speed, but disables healing on the target.
- **Folotiknife**: Craftable, very high attack speed. right click to dash.
- **Spoon**: Craftable, iron paxel, increase block interaction range when off-handed.
# Potion effects
![Effects icons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b133f3a83e1dd8d11585f152f5a2c73be418d16d.png)
## Imaginaric
These effect are required to use **Frieren's Staff**, Divine Imaginary is infinite Imaginary
![Imaginary and divine imaginary potion recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8de14748f2b6b4579529ec29ab74b94149903e52.png)
- Amethyst + Water = **Imaginary**
- Osimate + Imaginary = **Divine Imaginary**
## Antiheal
This effect disables healing on its target

![Antiheal potion recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4dfbae60517e8e7d3ac94bdad3f968475f6822d0.png)
- Netherite Scrap + Water = **Antiheal**
